views.rationale: Net income turned positive to $1.45 billion in Q2 2017 from a $1.47 billion loss in Q2 2016, while Caterpillar profit rose 46% to $802 million.
Caterpillar Q2 sales rose 10% to $11.331 billion and profit per share up 45% to $1.35, versus Boeing revenues falling to $22.739 billion from $24.755 billion.
Boeing's operating margin improved to 10.4% for the three months ended June 30, 2017 from 2.9% a year earlier, while Apple only reported share repurchases with no growth metrics.
GOOGL reported 21% YoY revenue growth (23% constant‑currency) versus GS's 12% net‑revenue increase for the first half of 2017
GS net revenues rose 12% YoY, while JNJ's worldwide sales grew only 1.8% in the first fiscal six months
